title: Ruleset hardening: promote five low-risk rules to Error
summary: Removes the Warning overrides for AL0254, AL0523, AA0242, AA0224 and AW0007 from the base ruleset so they apply as errors. The findings are fixed in code across many localization layers, with narrow suppressions kept for accepted existing behavior.
key_points: Five rules (AL0254, AL0523, AA0242, AA0224, AW0007) now apply at Error level in the repo ruleset
Partial-record loads fixed by adding fields to SetLoadFields calls
Missing captions added and prepayment test report request options separated from the internal option
New Employee Ledger Entry keys added for Closed by Entry No. and NL proposal sorting
46 ID-qualified suppressions kept; overrides drop from 81 to 76
